vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: rating
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle provides a local rating and logging utility that stores data in the user's home directory (~/.local/share/rating). The primary script (scripts/script.sh) manages various commands by appending user-provided strings to log files and offering basic search and export functionality. While the code contains several logical inconsistencies, such as unreachable case branches for 'export' and 'status' and a failure to utilize the RATING_DIR environment variable mentioned in SKILL.md, it exhibits no signs of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized command execution.

llm.summary: The skill implements a local rating tool that mostly matches its description, but there are inconsistencies between the SKILL.md and the shipped script (and the script output in the prompt is truncated), so you should inspect the full script and understand local file writes before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (rating, add/list/export/status) aligns with the included script: the script implements many rating-related commands and local exports. However SKILL.md claims RATING_DIR can be set to change the data directory, while the script hardcodes DATA_DIR to ${HOME}/.local/share/rating and does not read RATING_DIR — a documentation vs implementation mismatch.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md gives simple usage examples and mentions the data directory; it does not describe the extent of local file writes. The script creates and writes many log files under the user's home (~/.local/share/rating), reads and concatenates them for status/export, and prints file contents to stdout. It does not appear to read unrelated system paths or network endpoints in the visible portion, but the provided script output was truncated mid-file so the end of the script was not visible.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec; this is an instruction-only skill with an included shell script. There are no remote downloads or package installs declared. Risk from install mechanism is low.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required env vars or credentials (OK). SKILL.md suggests a configurable RATING_DIR, but the script ignores that and derives DATA_DIR from HOME — inconsistent. The script implicitly relies on HOME and writes to the user's home directory, which is expected for this kind of local utility but worth noting.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no system-wide changes are requested. The script creates and writes files in ~/.local/share/rating (user-owned area) which is normal for a local tool and does not modify other skills or global agent configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This appears to be a local rating utility that stores data under ~/.local/share/rating and exposes commands for run, export, status, search, etc. Before installing or running it: (1) review the full scripts/script.sh content (the provided listing was truncated) to ensure there are no hidden network calls or unexpected commands at the end; (2) be aware it will create and append logs in your home directory and may store any input you give (do not enter secrets or sensitive data); (3) the SKILL.md claims RATING_DIR can be set but the script does not honor that — if you need the data stored elsewhere, either modify the script or create a symlink; (4) run the script in a sandbox or with limited permissions if you want to test it first; and (5) if possible, ask the publisher to confirm the missing/truncated portion of the script and to fix the RATING_DIR discrepancy.
